cards.buyer_task: Engineer needs to locate a capability that fits the installed system before contacting a supplier.
cards.why: Engineer needs to locate a capability that fits the installed system before contacting a supplier. Transfer the information relationship so the first object helps this decision.
cards.typography_reason: Compare editorial orientation with compact technical labels; keep unfamiliar abbreviations expanded.
cards.density_reason: Use more open spacing around a system map; use compact aligned rows for capability matching.
visual_object_candidates: capability ledger: system / need / scope / deliverables
system boundary map: equipment / interfaces / responsibility / handover
cards.mobile_transformation: Stack each need and its scope on mobile; maps need a labelled linear equivalent.
cards.reject: Reject transferred claims, vendor identity, fixed fonts/palette and missing decision content. These references establish information anatomy; they do not prove a spatial layout or aesthetic preference.

cards.typography_reason: Compare a restrained technical heading with a more expressive scope statement; specification text stays readable.

visual_object_candidates: scope register: inputs / constraints / outputs / exclusions
commissioning chain: baseline / engineering / test / acceptance

cards.reject: Reject transferred claims, vendor identity, fixed fonts/palette and missing decision content. These references establish information anatomy; they do not prove a spatial layout or aesthetic preference.
